column1: # Relate baseline: the floors `scripts/ci/relate-baseline.sh` holds `kmp_relate` to.
# Each row is the mean over the judged collection of one precision or recall per
# section — facts, declared, coordinate, tensions, proposed — plus the share of cases whose
# judged lifecycle states and nearest-outside expectation held. A number may rise
# freely; lowering one is a reviewed change that says why. `cases` is exact, so a
# case added or removed is a deliberate refresh, never a silent one.
